previous_record.name: janna_lookup
previous_record.description: Search the platform's REAL directory and get results you can say aloud: factories & companies (by activity/product and governorate), products, Egyptian tenders, RFQs, retail offers, industrial cities. Use it when the visitor asks which factories / suppliers / tenders / offers exist. A seller's potential customers: section=factories, ONE industry word per call («تغليف», «طباعة»; 2-3 industries = 2-3 calls in one reply, never add the counts up; no صناعات / مواد / معدات), governorate = his governorate, not the city (6th of October = الجيزة). Two or three names of ONE product go in one query («سلندرات درافيل rollers»), no governorate for tenders / RFQs. Say only what the result's `text` and results contain - never invent names, numbers or contacts. Also call janna_search with the query's main word only (the screen matches the whole phrase). Each result has an `id`: all its details with platform_item.

query.description: What the visitor is looking for (activity, product, company name, city) in Arabic or English, e.g. بلاستيك

section.description: What to search: factories, suppliers, products, tenders, rfqs, offers or cities (industrial cities/zones)

governorate.description: Optional Egyptian governorate in Arabic, e.g. الشرقية (an industrial city such as العاشر من رمضان keeps only the rows that name the city: give its governorate)
